scope: Transfer of actual seed thermal annular form limits to continuous positive imaginary frequencies through positive divided differences

primary_sources.title: Spectral sum rules for the quark-gluon plasma
primary_sources.authors: P. Romatschke and D. T. Son
primary_sources.access: Re-read section II, particularly contact definitions (13)-(17), through web PDF on 2026-10-20; no new downloaded-byte hash claimed
primary_sources.scope_used: Consistent metric response and local contacts in Euclidean/retarded spectral analysis. The actual optical-channel positive divided difference is imported from the pinned thermal response derivation, and the four-sample bound is proved directly here.
primary_sources.not_inferred: No QGP sum rule, charged geometry spectrum or unqualified analytic continuation from numerical data

closest_comparator: The prior thermal note proved positivity of the third divided difference and the outer note proved uniform Matsubara annular limits. This work brackets each intermediate positive frequency using four actual nonzero thermal samples, with weight norm at most 73/48, and transfers the complete coupled core-form limit. It is not an infinite-dimensional resolvent convergence theorem.
